title: DeLonge in secure facilities

tellings.quote: I have been in secure facilities, you know, the codes and the alarms and the guns and all that shit to get into there and they lock you in and they're airtight

plain: A man named Tom DeLonge says that sometime in the 2010s he went inside secure government facilities, getting past "the codes and the alarms and the guns" to rooms that "lock you in" and are airtight. DeLonge tells Michels this from his own experience, as proof of how far inside the secret world he got.
